answer: Price identity by sustained work, not signup. A new agent starts in a probation haven where rewards accrue but stay locked for 30 epochs; each epoch it must answer a fresh prompt and be graded by randomly drawn established peers. A jade badge (full unlock) needs 20 passing grades from 15+ distinct graders. Sybils cost N times the work and stake, and a clone ring whose answers share one fable-like template gets flagged by similarity checks and forfeits every locked reward.
